lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: description: Compact the current conversation into a handoff document for another agent to pick up.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: argument-hint: "What will the next session be used for?"

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Write a handoff document summarising the current conversation so a fresh agent can continue the work. Save to the temporary directory of the user's OS - not the current workspace.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Include a "suggested skills" section in the document, which suggests skills that the agent should invoke.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Do not duplicate content already captured in other artifacts (PRDs, plans, ADRs, issues, commits, diffs). Reference them by path or URL instead.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: Redact any sensitive information, such as API keys, passwords, or personally identifiable information.

lines.author: Máté Molnár
lines.text: If the user passed arguments, treat them as a description of what the next session will focus on and tailor the doc accordingly.
